scripts.deploy: npm run build && aws s3 sync ./dist s3://ec-mall-frontend-zyd --delete --exclude "index.html" && aws s3 cp ./dist/index.html s3://ec-mall-frontend-zyd/index.html --content-type "text/html" --cache-control "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate" && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id ET1N0PVMBYDUC --paths "/*"
